name: UV Insurance (Union Life Mutual Assurance Company / L'Union-Vie, compagnie mutuelle d'assurance; UV Assurance)
ownership: Mutual (UV Mutuelle), founded 1889 as L'Union Saint-Joseph; Drummondville, QC. Website is uvassurance.ca (not uv.ca as listed in data/companies.csv)
regulator: AMF (Quebec); CARLI capital framework. BMO block transfer was an OSFI-regulated assumption reinsurance

metrics.note: +35% from 2,353.6 (2024), mainly the BMO Insurance block acquired June 2025. Summary consolidated statements; full FS available on request.
Bonds 1,926.0 (81%), common stock 121.3, preferred stock 103.3, private investments 102.4, money market 57.5, loans 52.6, derivatives 5.0. Plus cash 25.8. 1,675.1 in 2024.
Plus insurance contract asset 36.8 (new, tied to a small product in the BMO transaction per SVP Parenteau).
No seg funds on balance sheet; UV distributes Assumption Life's seg funds under a 2021 agreement. Investment contract liabilities (deposits/annuities) C$159.3mm.

metrics.metric: Income from insurance activities (IFRS 17 insurance revenue)
metrics.note: 225.5 in 2024 (+27%). Total income from insurance activities 8.4 (-3.5 in 2024).
6.6 in 2024 (+20%), 11.5 in 2023. Net investment income 18.8 (44.9); net insurance finance income 14.9 (-26.5). No core measure; no interim reporting.
Includes C$12.3mm FVOCI gains (preferred shares strong, per SVP Parenteau) and C$4.6mm DB pension remeasurement.
+9.7% from 256.4; retained earnings 257.8, AOCI 23.5. Equity/assets 8.9% after acquisition.

Latest numeric disclosure (2024 AR). For 2025 the company says only that the ratio 'remains above target/internal targets' after the acquisition (AR 2025; press release 2026-03-24). Internal target not published.
No debt; bank overdraft nil (1.25 in 2024); lease obligations 0.2. Unlevered (inferred).
No AM Best, S&P, Moody's, DBRS or Fitch rating found.
No internal investment department disclosed; assets managed externally by Sun Life Capital (SLC Management) since 2025 tender. Board Investment Committee of 5 directors.
'Nearly 300' in AR 2025 (Quebec, Ontario, New Brunswick); engagement 92%.
Up from ~300k; ~250k policies pre-deal plus ~200k BMO policies (~C$50mm premiums).

business_mix.basis: Not disclosed quantitatively; summary statements give one insurance revenue line (C$285.5mm, FY2025). Qualitative: individual life & critical illness (incl. acquired BMO direct-marketing block), group insurance (Quebec SMEs), investment/retirement (annuities, deposits; Assumption seg funds distributed).
business_mix.note: AR 2025: individual insurance 'robust growth' (acquisition plus 1,000+ new advisors signed); group insurance 'stable', strategic redefinition to expand outside Quebec. 2024 AR: >C$190mm paid benefits; 330,000 mutualists.

pm_structure.summary: Fully outsourced general account. In 2025 UV ran a tender for the management of its assets and appointed Sun Life Capital (SLC Management, Sun Life's institutional asset manager) as manager of 'our various portfolios'; a first Responsible Investment Policy (ESG integration) was adopted at the same time. Oversight by the board Investment Committee (chaired by ex-FÉRIQUE CEO Fabienne Lacoste) and the SVP Actuarial & Finance. The prior manager is not disclosed.
manager_entities: Sun Life Capital / SLC Management (appointed 2025 after RFP)
bullets: 2025 RFP for asset management won by Sun Life Capital; transition 'virtually seamless' (Chair's message, AR 2025)
New Responsible Investment Policy (2025) integrates ESG factors into investment strategy; part of 2025-2030 Sustainable Development Strategy
Board Investment Committee of five directors (two CFAs, two FSAs, one CPA); ex-Addenda Capital executive Benoît Durocher joined 2025
No internal CIO or trading desk disclosed; finance/actuarial under SVP Pierre Parenteau
Private investments C$102mm (4% of investments; type not disclosed) and loans C$53mm held alongside the bond-heavy (81%) book

rotation_commentary.text: Asset management re-tendered and moved to Sun Life Capital (SLC); Chair expects assets to 'grow in line with existing policies' incl. new Responsible Investment Policy.
Balance-sheet data: bonds +C$567mm (to 1,926), common stock +C$88mm (to 121), loans +C$36mm, preferreds -C$40mm, as BMO block assets were absorbed; money market up to C$57mm.
SVP Parenteau: IFRS 17 'has the potential to produce more volatile results'; UV is 'changing its strategies to produce more stable and predictable results' (ALM/accounting stance, not a mix target).
Acquisition framed as 'diversify its risk ... optimizing operations and the use of its capital'; 2030 Strategic Framework adopted (disciplined growth, technology, operational excellence).

repos.text: Not disclosed; no repo line on the summary balance sheet.

structured_indirect.text: Private investments C$102.4mm (type not disclosed; mapped to private equity in repo analysis) and loans C$52.6mm. Derivative assets C$5.0mm (liabilities C$3.8mm in 2024); instruments not disclosed.
Assumption reinsurance of BMO block: insurance contract liabilities rose C$768mm to C$2,669mm; reinsurance assets C$656mm indicate large ceded share.

leverage.note: No debt capital of any kind; mutual funded entirely by retained earnings (C$258mm) and AOCI.

deals.text: Acquired closed block from BMO Life Assurance (BMO Insurance) by assumption reinsurance, closed 2025-06-06: ~200k policies, ~C$50mm premiums (180k direct-marketing CI/term/accident; ~15-30k par whole life). Price undisclosed. Largest deal in UV's history.
Fasken lists 'UV Insurance completes acquisition of a closed block' (Feb 2026) among its deal experience; which party it advised could not be verified (page blocked).
Distribution agreement with Assumption Life (effective 2021-09-15): UV markets Assumption's segregated funds and registered investment accounts Canada-wide.
Asset-management mandate awarded to Sun Life Capital (SLC Management) after tender.
1,000+ new advisors signed distribution agreements; new actuarial R&D team for group insurance.

sponsorships.text: C$1mm+ donated (education, health, social inclusion); policy of giving ~10% of net income to community causes.
FORCE-UQTR cybersecurity training program for SMEs with Université du Québec à Trois-Rivières; SOCODEVI international cooperation (Morocco COOPFAM).
Course des Chênes-toi (Drummondville run); Fondation du Cégep de Drummondville; ACEE student entrepreneurship fair.

Sun Life group (SLC Management) as general-account manager since 2025.

notes: UV is a 135-year-old Drummondville mutual that grew total assets 35% to C$3.2bn in 2025 by assuming ~200k BMO Insurance policies, doubling its membership to 500k+. Its C$2.4bn general account (81% bonds, ~4% private investments, 5% common, 4% preferreds) is fully outsourced: a 2025 tender moved all portfolios to Sun Life Capital (SLC Management) alongside a first Responsible Investment Policy, with oversight by a board Investment Committee chaired by former FÉRIQUE CEO Fabienne Lacoste. Equity/assets fell to 8.9% post-deal; CARLI was 172% at YE2024 and 'above target' at YE2025. Leadership changes in 2026: CEO Christian Mercier out, Charles Guay (ex-Standard Life Canada, Manulife Quebec) in from 2026-09-14. Personal library not available in this session; public sources used. WebSearch budget ran out before French-press checks (Les Affaires, Journal de l'assurance) could be completed.
